prerequisites: Minimum 80% of basic and compulsory credits completed

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to complete an internship in a company performing professional tasks in the field of mechanical engineering.
learning_outcomes.code: CEA03, CG01, CG02, CG05, CG06, CG07

syllabus_topics: Continuum mechanics and theory of structures
Work in companies, institutions or professional offices related to mechanical engineering.
Work or projects in construction management, industrial organization, production process management, budget monitoring, safety coordination and quality control.
Research and development work on any topic related to mechanical engineering.
assessment_rules: To be considered presented for any call, students must have completed 150 hours of internship at the company and submitted the report. The qualification will be awarded by the university tutor based on their monitoring (30%), the submitted report (30%), and the company supervisor's report (40%). If recognition is requested, the student can recognize the internships by accrediting extracurricular internships, provided the number of hours is 300 or more, and certain credit requirements are met. In the case of recognition, the student must submit a report, which accounts for 100% of the grade. To pass the course, the overall minimum grade awarded by the tutor in their report must be 5 out of 10.
